title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Responsibilities**

* Own product development from discovery to launch and adoption.
* Analyze user, business, and operational data to guide decisions.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and business teams.
* Convert business problems into clear product requirements.
* Manage iterative delivery and ensure timely launches.
* Define success metrics and track product outcomes.
* Identify AI/LLM opportunities and use AI tools to improve workflows.

**Requirements**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in SQL or analytics tools and metric definition.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong product sense and understanding of user needs.
* Experience managing complex platforms and cross-functional dependencies.
* Proactive ownership and ability to work independently.
* Strong understanding of AI tools and their product applications.
* Platform, marketplace, or internal tooling experience is a plus.
* Exposure to ERP/SAP systems is a plus.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.

As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.

Visa is seeking a seasoned Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.

As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.

Responsibilities:

* Customer-Centric Product Vision: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* 5+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 2+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager (POS, Retail)
job_description:
Roles & Responsibilities

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – POS to own the strategy, roadmap, customer

experience, and business outcomes for Ginesys’s POS portfolio across Cloud POS, Offline

POS, Mobile POS, and omnichannel store journeys. You will combine deep retail and POS

expertise with strong product craft to modernise a mission-critical store platform and shape

the future of intelligent store commerce.

Key Responsibilities

1. POS Product Strategy, Market & Discovery

● Own the long-term product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Cloud, Offline, Mobile,

and Omnichannel POS within Ginesys One.

● Build deep understanding of retailers, store associates, market shifts, and global

POS competition to identify whitespace and differentiated product bets.

● Prioritise roadmap investments using customer value, market opportunity,

competitive advantage, revenue potential, and ROI; distinguish scalable needs from

one-off customisation.

● Shape the modernisation and migration strategy for existing POS capabilities while

protecting continuity for enterprise retailers.

2. Modern Store & Omnichannel Experience

● Reimagine core store journeys across billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, returns,

inventory visibility, assisted selling, and endless aisle.

● Design seamless experiences across stores, e-commerce, marketplaces, and

customer channels, including Mobile POS and checkout-anywhere experiences.

● Own product quality across speed, usability, reliability, offline resilience, multi-device

environments, and high-volume enterprise store networks.

3. Platform, Architecture & Product Execution

● Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on APIs, data flows, sync, security,

performance, observability, extensibility, and backward compatibility.

● Ensure seamless integration with ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM, loyalty, payments, tax,

e-commerce, and third- party retail ecosystems.

● Translate strategy into crisp requirements, prototypes, workflows, and measurable

release outcomes; make sound trade-offs between speed, technical foundations, and

long-term platform leverage.

● Lead cross-functional execution with Design, Engineering, QA, Customer Success,

and Implementation from discovery through launch and adoption.

4. AI-First Store Innovation

● Identify meaningful AI-native opportunities across checkout, associate assistance,

store operations, recommendations, automation, fraud/risk, and customer

experience.

● Use contemporary AI and rapid prototyping tools hands-on to validate concepts

faster and explore intelligent assistance, natural-language interfaces, and agentic

store workflows.

● Challenge legacy retail workflows and help define what an intelligent, connected

store experience should look like for the next decade.

5. Business Outcomes, Adoption & Monetisation

● Own measurable outcomes across adoption, usage depth, customer satisfaction,

retention, revenue influence, and expansion.

● Define success metrics before launch, track post-launch performance, and use data

and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

● Partner with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, competitive

differentiation, and monetisation; equip Customer Success and Support to drive

adoption and customer value.

Pay: ₹2,730,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Must have a minimum of 8 years of experience in product management with significant ownership of POS
* Must have experience leading a product team and owning the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Cloud, Offline, and Mobile POS
* Must have experience building enterprise-grade products requiring offline resilience, high availability, and large-scale integrations (ERP, OMS, WMS, CRM)
* Must have experience in omnichannel retail journeys including billing, payments, promotions, loyalty, and inventory visibility
* Must have experience in SaaS product lifecycle management and ERP integrations
* Must be willing to work from the Gurgaon office 5 days a week and attend a face-to-face final interview round

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Position Summary**

CDK Global is seeking an **Associate Product Manager** to support OEM and Enterprise initiatives focused on improving the automotive ownership and service experience for dealers and consumers. This role is ideal for an early-career product professional who is passionate about learning the automotive ecosystem, building strong stakeholder relationships, and developing exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

The Associate Product Manager will work closely with OEM partners, Product Managers, Program Managers, Engineering teams, UX teams, and business stakeholders to understand OEM objectives, dealer operational challenges, and customer experience opportunities. A key responsibility will be developing expertise in OEM programs and understanding how they influence dealer performance, customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term loyalty.

This role will support initiatives that help OEMs achieve key success metrics, including customer satisfaction and loyalty measures often reflected in industry benchmarking programs such as J.D. Power studies and OEM-specific satisfaction programs. The Associate Product Manager will help translate OEM requirements into product enhancements that improve both digital and in-store customer experiences across the service journey.

As the automotive service industry evolves, this role will contribute to product strategies that extend beyond online appointment scheduling to support a broader Fixed Operations ecosystem, including service lane experiences, scheduled maintenance programs, OEM parts and tire sales, marketing and customer retention capabilities, service recommendations, digital engagement solutions, and emerging payment options such as Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL).

**Key Responsibilities**

**OEM Program Knowledge & Product Support**

* Develop a deep understanding of OEM service programs, customer experience initiatives, and dealer operational processes.

* Learn how OEM objectives translate into dealer workflows, customer outcomes, and product requirements.

* Support Product Managers in evaluating OEM requests, enhancements, and strategic opportunities.

* Research competitive offerings, market trends, and industry best practices.

* Build domain expertise across Fixed Operations, Service, Customer Retention, and Digital Retailing solutions.

**Customer & Dealer Experience Focus**

* Develop an understanding of the dealer service journey from online scheduling through in-store service experiences.

* Support initiatives focused on:

* Online service appointment scheduling

* In-store service advisor experiences

* Scheduled maintenance programs

* OEM parts and tire sales

* Recall and service campaigns

* Customer communications and marketing

* Vehicle health and maintenance recommendations

* BNPL and flexible payment options

* Service retention and loyalty programs

* Assist in gathering feedback from dealers, OEM stakeholders, and internal teams to identify enhancement opportunities.

**Product Execution & Coordination**

* Support the definition and documentation of product requirements, user stories, and business objectives.

* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, and release planning activities.

* Coordinate with Engineering, UX, and Quality Assurance teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

* Track feature progress and help ensure alignment with business and customer objectives.

* Assist with launch activities, adoption planning, and post-release analysis.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Deliver clear, professional, and effective written and verbal communications.

* Create presentations, requirements documents, executive summaries, meeting notes, and status updates.

* Facilitate discussions between Product, Engineering, OEM stakeholders, and business teams.

* Translate complex business or technical concepts into clear, actionable information for various audiences.

* Maintain product documentation and communicate decisions, priorities, and next steps.

**Data & Performance Analysis**

* Monitor and analyze product performance metrics and customer feedback.

* Develop an understanding of key OEM success measures, including:

* Customer satisfaction scores

* Service retention metrics

* Dealer engagement and adoption metrics

* Loyalty and repeat visit indicators

* J.D. Power-related performance drivers

* OEM program participation and effectiveness

**Learning & Product Development**

* Demonstrate a strong desire to learn the automotive industry, OEM strategies, dealer operations, and customer experience best practices.

* Continuously build knowledge of Fixed Operations processes and emerging service technologies.

* Participate in OEM discussions, and internal strategy sessions.

* Develop product management fundamentals including requirements gathering, prioritization, roadmap planning, and product discovery.

**Qualifications**

**Preferred:**

* **1 Year related work experience or relevant internship as product owner, product manager**
* **Experience in Agile software/DevOps methodologies & working with globally distributed teams.**

**Education/Experience**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience**
* **1+ years of Product Owner or Product Management and/or equivalent experience: internships or education.**
* **Demonstrated ability to learn new concepts.**
* **Excellent written & verbal communication skills.**
* **Willingness to take on new challenges in dynamic environment.**
* **Strong analytical skills, ability to break complex ideas into actionable tasks.**
* **Limited travel.**

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)**

At CDK, we believe inclusion and diversity are essential in inspiring meaningful connections among our people. We foster an open and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, enabling everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and make a meaningful impact.

CDK is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with fairness, dignity, and respect. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, caste, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, nationality, ethnic origin, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

  

**Non-Discrimination and Reasonable Accommodation**

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of their role satisfactorily. CDK is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or other protected needs in accordance with applicable laws, unless doing so would impose an undue hardship on the organization. CDK retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position as needed.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description**

About the Role
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive and manage the requirements and roadmap to transform and continuously improve the customer experience for a high-quality SaaS solution. You will define new product capabilities and integrations that streamline how customers are provisioned, onboarded, managed, as well as engage with our product. You will drive usability studies and business workflow research to recommend, design, and implement ways to increase the velocity at which we can meet customer needs. You will work across the company with all aspects of product delivery, including business operations, IT operations, sales, and support.
  
You will serve as the product owner for your area, coordinating product development teams and monitoring progress throughout the development cycle. You will manage pre-release product activities (beta, preview), and coordinate cross-functional teams for product launch and company readiness activities, including internal training. This role also provides a significant opportunity for leadership via cross-team collaboration with the other product teams and businesses to achieve our company goals.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, WhatsApp - India
job_description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.WhatsApp Product Managers work with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, researchers and other partners to build products. We are looking for entrepreneurial Product Managers who combine long-term strategic thinking with urgency, product craft and effective execution.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, WhatsApp - India Responsibilities:**

* Lead a complex product area by defining its vision, strategy, and measures of success, while considering the wider WhatsApp and company context.
* Identify and prioritize the most significant user and product opportunities, adapting the strategy as new evidence and context emerge.
* Translate strategy into a coherent roadmap across multiple workstreams, driving progress against goals and resolving dependencies and blockers.
* Build alignment across adjacent product teams and partner functions, resolving divergent goals and creating shared strategies where needed.
* Use qualitative research, quantitative analysis, and market insight to inform product decisions and influence the broader product organization.
* Communicate the product strategy, trade-offs, and progress with clarity to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* Raise the effectiveness of the team and support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional partners through mentorship and coaching.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 3 years in Product Management
* Experience leading consumer product strategy and execution at significant scale
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across the full product lifecycle, from defining product vision and requirements through launch, measurement, and iteration
* Experience using user research, experimentation, and large-scale data to identify opportunities, make trade-offs, and drive measurable product outcomes
* Experience integrating diverse user needs, product requirements, and competitive context into a coherent strategy
* Experience influencing across organizational boundaries and aligning senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, including bringing clarity to complex product decisions
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building products for diverse international audiences and markets
* Experience defining and validating zero-to-one consumer product opportunities
* Experience in designing audience, privacy or identity controls that help people share confidently
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or team workflows while applying responsible AI practices
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building consumer products
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in a consumer-focused technology company, with in-market experience in India
* Experience working with payment infrastructure in emerging markets
* Experience building and scaling early-stage growth efforts

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Senior
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery & Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap & Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution & Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high-quality products
* **Adoption & Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

**Additional Information**

The recruitment process includes online assessment as a first step (logic) - we send it via e-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

Work Location: Strategy Chennai office — full-time, Monday to Friday

job_description:
We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Product Management Executive to support product planning, data analysis, documentation, and coordination with design and development teams. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of product functionality, strong Excel skills, and a proactive approach to managing tasks and improving product performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management: Understand product features, functionality, workflows, and requirements, and support day-to-day product activities.
* Data Analysis: Analyze product-related data, prepare reports, and identify insights to support decision-making.
* Excel & Reporting: Use MS Excel or Google Sheets for data tracking, analysis, and reporting.
* Product Documentation: Maintain product requirements, feature lists, workflows, and related documentation.
* Team Coordination: Work with designers, developers, and internal teams to communicate requirements and track progress.
* Product Improvement: Identify issues, analyze gaps, and suggest improvements to product functionality and user experience.
* Task Management: Track deliverables, monitor timelines, and ensure assigned tasks are completed efficiently.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 6 months to 1 year of relevant experience in product management, product operations, business analysis, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Basic understanding of product management and product development processes.
* Basic knowledge of Figma, UI/UX, or software development concepts.
* Good communication, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Responsible, organized, and capable of taking ownership of assigned tasks.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager-Power Markets
job_description:
**Job Description**

**-------------------------------------------------------**

Designation- Product Manager-Power Markets

Experience- 4-7 Years

Location- Noida Sector 125

We are looking for a Product Manager with strong end-to-end product management capabilities, including requirement gathering, product roadmap creation, feature prioritization, stakeholder alignment, sprint/development tracking, testing, UAT, release planning, deployment, implementation and product onboarding.

The role requires strong experience in preparing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, product documentation, solution documents and presentations, while working closely with engineering, QA, business and customer teams. The candidate should also be capable of driving market analysis, competitive benchmarking, product enhancement and new product/feature evaluation.

Experience in Power Utilities, Power Procurement, Energy Markets, Power Exchanges, Open Access,Bilateral procurement and C&I customers is preferred, along with exposure to demand forecasting, market forecasting and statistical/ML-based forecasting models.

Do you want to be a part of enabling the next wave of innovation in communication protocols, building sensors and cutting-edge hardware?

Does working with IoT devices, sensors, wearables, controllers which can seamlessly merge the digital world with the physical world around us interests you?

Who we are?

We are working on IoT solutions that can be used to solve massive scale problems by connecting things to people.

As a company we are digitizing the electricity distribution grids to bring down network losses and ensure that electricity reaches every household.

We do this by building sensors, controllers, low power edge devices, connect and manage multiple sensors with our ecosystem.

We have been awarded as the Startup of the Year 2018 and our wireless technology in 2020, has been awarded by India Smart Grid Forum, Government of India.

We have also been mentored by Cisco and Qualcomm in their startup accelerators.

We are a Venture Capital funded company and have raised our A1 round series in 2025.

We -

 Are a team of technologists from diverse backgrounds

 Obsess over design and product journey

 Obsess over our customer’s needs and experience

 Are owners. We love building new innovative technologies, and improving our existing ones

 Wear multiple hats. We enjoy the prototyping and tinkering stages, as well as the rigor of making solutions production-ready

 Are fast-growing, agile and collaborative

You-

 Enjoy seeing the impact your work has on real customers

 Enjoy being a part of a creation that can shape the future of the world as we know it

 Enjoy working with the cofounders and the founding team of a growing startup

 Are comfortable in an agile environment and create order from ambiguity

 Are excited about the incredible opportunity connected products represent

 Build strong teams with others as passionate as you about this mission

 Take ownership and doing whatever it takes to get the job done

 Want to create applications at a massive scale used by millions of people

 Use data to make decisions and validate assumptions

 Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best

Pay: ₹777,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your Expected CTC in LPA? (15)
* What is your notice period in days? (30)

Experience:

* overall: 4 years (Required)
* Product Management: 4 years (Required)
* Program Management: 4 years (Required)
* Power Procurement: 3 years (Required)
* Demand & Market Forecasting: 4 years (Required)
* Automated Bidding & Procurement Optimization: 4 years (Required)
* Stakeholder Management: 4 years (Required)
* API Integration: 3 years (Required)
* Power trading: 3 years (Required)
* Open Access: 3 years (Required)
* Energy Consulting: 3 years (Required)
* utility solutions: 3 years (Required)
* C&I energy management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

**What we do...**

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Product Manager role...**

This is a full-stack product role with a primary focus on GDS connectivity within the distribution portfolio. You will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and opportunity identification through requirements definition, delivery, go-to-market, and post-launch evaluation. Working closely with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will shape product direction, support feature delivery, and define clear success measures to ensure outcomes align with customer needs and business goals.

**What you'll do...**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and customer validation through requirements definition, delivery, launch, and evaluation.
* Shape and execute the product roadmap in alignment with customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer-centred research and business analysis with hoteliers, connectivity partners, and internal subject matter experts.
* Identify, define, prioritise, and validate product opportunities, features, and enhancements.
* Partner with the Design and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, shape solutions, and support effective delivery.
* Prioritise and maintain the product backlog, ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-value work.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to plan releases, manage dependencies, and communicate progress and milestones.
* Support go-to-market planning, product positioning, internal enablement, and customer and partner communications.
* Define and monitor success metrics, including adoption, customer satisfaction, revenue impact, delivery performance, product-market fit, and operational quality.
* Stay informed on market, customer, competitor, and technology developments, including the effective use of AI tools and AI-augmented workflows.

**What you'll have...**

* 5+ years’ product management experience in B2B SaaS, travel, hospitality technology, or a related domain.
* Experience in hotel distribution, channel management, revenue management, connectivity, GDS integrations, or another travel-related domain is highly desirable.
* Experience working with API-based products, system integrations, and cross-functional delivery teams in Agile or Kanban environments.
* A proven track record of delivering products or features that achieve customer adoption, commercial outcomes, and measurable business value.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and technical business analysis skills, with confidence using customer insights and data to inform decisions.
* Creative and adaptable problem-solving skills, with the ability to think outside the box, develop practical solutions to complex challenges, and demonstrably leverage AI tools and capabilities to accelerate outcomes.
* A solid understanding of product management practices and the end-to-end product lifecycle, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs across customer, commercial, technical, and operational considerations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional workshops and build collaborative relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to meet customers, connectivity partners, and internal stakeholders, including at our head office in Sydney, Australia.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

Product Manager

Company: Eminence Technology  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Job Type: Full-time  
Location: Mohali / On-site  
Shift - Night Shift

Job Overview

Eminence Technology is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to lead product strategy, development, and lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will work closely with engineering, UI/UX, marketing, sales, and business teams to translate customer and business requirements into impactful product solutions.

The candidate should have strong analytical and communication skills, a good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies, and hands-on experience managing digital products from ideation to launch and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and execute **product vision, strategy, and roadmap** aligned with business objectives.
* Gather and analyze customer, business, and market requirements.
* Create and maintain **PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation**.
* Prioritize product features and maintain the product backlog based on business value and customer needs.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, QA, marketing, and other stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Conduct **market research, competitor analysis, and user research** to identify product opportunities.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to ensure timely and quality product delivery.
* Monitor product performance using relevant **KPIs, metrics, and analytics**.
* Collect and analyze user feedback to identify areas for product enhancement.
* Participate in **Agile ceremonies**, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Identify product risks, dependencies, and challenges and work toward effective solutions.
* Continuously improve product features, usability, customer experience, and overall product performance.

Required Skills

* 4+ years of experience as a **Product Manager / Product Owner** or in a similar product-focused role.
* Strong understanding of **Product Strategy and Product Lifecycle Management**.
* Experience with **PRDs, User Stories, Wireframes, and Acceptance Criteria**.
* Strong knowledge of **Agile and Scrum methodologies**.
* Excellent stakeholder and cross-functional team management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Understanding of **UI/UX principles and customer-centric product development**.
* Experience working with tools such as **Jira, Confluence, Figma, Mixpanel, or GA4** is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working on **SaaS, AI/ML, EdTech, Web, or Mobile products**.
* Understanding of product analytics and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience taking products from **ideation to launch and post-launch optimization**.
* Knowledge of APIs, databases, and software development processes will be an added advantage.

Why Join Eminence Technology?

* Work on innovative and technology-driven products.
* Opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to modern technologies and product development practices.
* Growth-oriented and dynamic work environment.

Apply Now: If you are passionate about building impactful products and have the required experience, we would love to hear from you.

Work Location: In person

Pay: Up to ₹1,700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

Responsibilities:

At Principal, we are looking for a dedicated Product Manager II to join our dynamic team in Pune, Maharashtra, India. This is an outstanding opportunity to lead and mentor a team of product managers while influencing the strategic direction of our products.

**Key Responsibilities**

Define and complete product strategy aligned with business and enterprise objectives.

Use customer, market, business, and partner insights to find opportunities and prioritize investments.

  

* Define key business outcomes, product requirements, and success measures for assigned products.
* Lead product discovery activities, including problem identification, experimentation, and validation.

Partner with Build, Engineering, Data, and business teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.

* Own and manage the product roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and delivery of measurable business value.
* Serve as Product Owner for Agile teams and drive effective product delivery through collaboration and dependency management.

Ensure successful product releases and communicate priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes to collaborators.

Establish and monitor product health metrics, benchmarks, and business outcomes to support data-driven decision making.

Build positive relationships with business, technology, operations, and customer-facing collaborators to drive alignment and change readiness.

Lead, mentor, coach, and develop Product Managers while encouraging a strong product culture across collaborating functions.

  

* Perform formal staff reporting responsibilities, including performance management, appraisals, goal setting, career development planning, and continuous feedback.
* Drive staffing, recruitment, onboarding, skill development, succession planning, and backup planning activities.
* Periodically assess the health and maturity of the product management practice and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to organizational initiatives, talent development programs, communities of practice, and enterprise-wide product excellence efforts.

Qualifications:

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of overall professional experience in Product Management experience in a highly collaborative, Agile environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing products through the full product lifecycle, including strategy, discovery, delivery, assessment, and optimization.
* Experience defining product vision, roadmap, and success metrics.

Strong collaborator management and relationship-building skills.

* Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

Experience applying qualitative and quantitative data to guide decisions and prioritize investments.

* Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum product teams and product ownership responsibilities.
* Exposure to customer-centric product development, experimentation, and outcome-based delivery models.

Additional Information:

Preferred Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong facilitation, collaborator engagement, and prioritization capabilities.

* Experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, Lean Product Management).
* Experience working in legacy as well as cloud-based platforms and modern digital product ecosystems.
* Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Miro, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Data-driven decision-making approach.

* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing without authority.
* Ability to mentor and develop team members while driving organizational outcomes.

Join us at Principal and be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and a drive for excellence. Let's build the future together!

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Position: Product Manager

Location: Gurgaon

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 4+ years

**Product Manager**
===================

**Reports To:** CTO / CEO

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Product Manager who can drive product planning, execution, and coordination across teams. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical understanding, and experience in managing product documentation and Agile product delivery processes. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and leadership to define and deliver innovative product solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Prepare and manage PRD (Product Requirement Documents), SRS (Software Requirement Specifications), BRD, and other product documentation.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements from stakeholders.
* Conduct market analysis, competitor analysis, and product feasibility studies.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, Design, and Business teams for successful product delivery.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with development teams throughout the SDLC lifecycle.
* Manage Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Utilize Jira for project tracking, sprint management, and requirement management.
* Collaborate with UI/UX teams and review wireframes, workflows, and prototypes using Figma.
* Monitor project timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, MIS, and presentations using Excel and other reporting tools.
* Support recruitment analysis, resource planning, and team coordination activities.
* Ensure timely delivery of product features aligned with business goals and customer needs.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of PRD, SRS, BRD, and product documentation practices.
* Hands-on experience with SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Working knowledge of Jira and Agile project management tools.
* Strong understanding of technology concepts, software development processes, APIs, and system integrations.
* Experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and market research.
* Proficiency in Figma for reviewing product flows, wireframes, and design concepts.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, reporting, and data analysis.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Professional and presentable personality with strong stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* MBA in Management or related field from a recognized institution.
* Experience working in a product-based, SaaS, logistics, fintech, or technology-driven organization.
* Exposure to Product Lifecycle Management and Product Strategy frameworks.
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams and business stakeholders effectively.

**Education**
-------------

MBA in Management or equivalent qualification from a recognized university.

Product Manager

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**  
At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  
  
If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  
  
Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  
Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

• Develop product roadmaps and define product features and requirements; • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, developers, and marketers to bring products to market effectively; • Analyze market trends, user feedback, and data to make strategic product decisions; • Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond; • Continuously optimize products based on performance metrics and user feedback. • Develop product roadmaps and define product features and requirements; • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including designers, developers, and marketers to bring products to market effectively; • Analyze market trends, user feedback, and data to make strategic product decisions; • Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond; • Continuously optimize products based on performance metrics and user feedback.

**Qualifications**

Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Economics, Bachelors - Information Technology, Bachelors - Marketing, Masters - Business Administration

**Certifications**

APMP-Practitioner Certification - Association for Proposal Management Professionals (APMP)Association for Proposal Management Professionals (APMP), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) - Six Sigma Global Institute (SSGI)Six Sigma Global Institute (SSGI), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) - Scaled Agile, Inc.Scaled Agile, Inc., PRINCE2 Foundation - TrilexTrilex, SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) - Scaled Agile, Inc.Scaled Agile, Inc.

**Required Skills**

Agile Methodology, Change Management, Client Relations, Collaboration Tools, Design Thinking, Executive Presence, Inclusion, Modernizing Operations, People Leadership, Personal Effectiveness, Risk Management, Storytelling

**Language**

English (Required)

**Language Proficiency -**

Proficient - C2

**Additional Job Location -**

**Job Type**

Regular

**Master Skill List -**

Product Management

**Remote Type -**

Hybrid

**Work Shift -**

Day Job (India)

**Why join Genpact?**  

* **Lead AI-powered transformation** – Drive innovation and solve real-world business challenges that matter
* **Make an impact** – Help global enterprises solve business challenges that matter
* **Accelerate your career** – Gain hands-on experience, mentorship, and world-class learning opportunities to stay ahead
* **Work with the best** – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day
* **Thrive in a values-driven culture** – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

  
Come join the 140,000+ coders, tech shapers, and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.  
Let’s build tomorrow together.  
  
Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.  
Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives including establishing marketing programs for new products or enhancements
* Conduct market research and market results-oriented analysis for major products and services
* Review and analyze complex major product lines and services
* Implement change delivery solutions for the portfolio's technology process work of low to moderate complexity
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations of global market dynamics, trends, and regulatory impact
* Oversee risk management to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with managers, stakeholders, scrum masters, project managers, and delivery team to resolve issues and achieve project goals
* Lead projects, teams, or serve as a mentor to less experienced staff

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management, product development, strategic planning, process management, change delivery experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.
* 5+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Experience leading Agile product delivery teams and managing backlogs within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and release planning activities.
* Experience working closely with engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive execution in matrixed organizational environments.

**Posting End Date:**

22 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About Turing**
================

Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world's leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you'll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing's most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you'll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**Advantages of joining Turing**
--------------------------------

* **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* **Contribute to leading-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

  

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to lead platform strategy, drive stakeholder alignment, and ensure seamless collaboration between business and technical teams throughout the product life cycle.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage the platform by organizing requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation with business and development stakeholders
* Create and deliver thorough training sessions to equip business users and stakeholders with platform usage skills and best practices
* Enable cross-departmental communication to define project goals and ensure a common understanding of platform features
* Assist in the design and development process by matching product features to changing business needs and regulatory demands
* Direct user acceptance testing efforts to confirm solutions fulfill specified requirements and quality benchmarks
* Partner with support and operations teams to maintain smooth platform upkeep and consistent performance
* Track and handle stakeholder expectations across the project lifecycle, maintaining transparency and prompt issue resolution
* Help enhance training materials and enablement approaches continuously, drawing on user feedback and platform changes
* Collaborate with a team of 3-5 colleagues and coordinate with third-party vendors when needed to achieve project goals

**Requirements**

* 12-18 years of overall IT experience, with a solid foundation in product management, product life cycle, product roadmap, and product vision
* Skills in connecting technical and business viewpoints to align platform capabilities with user needs
* Ability to manage stakeholders and balance varied expectations between business and technical groups
* Experience creating and delivering training programs suited to different user groups and proficiency levels
* Aptitude for converting complex business needs into clear, actionable technical specifications for development teams
* Proven track record of driving cross-functional collaboration and enabling effective communication across departments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:

  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Lead Digital Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is looking for a dynamic Lead Digital Product Manager to join the Wholesale Digital team. As the product management group responsible for the digital experiences to support servicing journeys for all Commercial and Corporate and Investment Banking clients, we have the ability to make immediate and long-lasting impacts to support our clients and their journey through their lifecycle with Wells Fargo.

**In this role, you will:**

Lead the development and execution of complex digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have impact across the enterprise with broad impact

Act as key participant in large-scale planning

Review and analyze complex digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area

Influence digital strategy for the business line requiring in-depth evaluation of multiple factors including intangibles or unprecedented factors

Make decisions in digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area requiring strong understanding of the business, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements

Lead a broad team of digital professionals to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives

Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and mid-level to senior managers to resolve issues and achieve goals

Potentially lead projects, teams or serve as a peer mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

5+ years of experience in financial services, preferably commercial or corporate banking.

5+years of experience in AI, product management, software development, program management, strategy, and/or related position in a consumer-oriented, technology-dependent environment in financial services or related industries.

**Desired Qualifications:**

Demonstrated success in end-to-end product management, from discovery through execution; experience developing strategy, roadmaps, business cases for a product or service.

Ability to translate business needs into analysis, designs and recommendations. Use analysis to identify and define business requirements, while supporting the validity of the final product.

Experience leading major online customer products, programs, and experience with significant platform/product redesign definitions and launch.

Ability to develop partnerships and collaborate with other businesses and functional areas.

Ability to execute in a fast paced, high demand environment while balancing multiple priorities.

Ability to influence successfully within a matrix environment and build effective business partnerships at all levels.

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills along with stakeholder management.

Ability to lead comfortably through ambiguity and facilitating discussion to explore the best possible solutions.

Recognized as a thought leader and subject matter expert.

Ability to be proactive, innovative, and creative in meeting customer and enterprise needs.

Demonstrable knowledge of product management discipline and agile software delivery.

Demonstrable experience of engaging technology teams and other stakeholders to support important business decisions.

Strong understanding of business transformation, digital, information architecture, software build, design thinking and service design techniques.

**Job Expectations:**

Ability to work on-site at approved location for three to four days per week.

Flexible work hours include overlap with pacific time zone

**Posting End Date:**

19 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.
