job_description:
**Job Description: Product Manager – CONSTRA**

Company: Bandhoo

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years

**About Bandhoo**

Bandhoo is a technology-driven company building SaaS solutions for construction project execution and workforce management.

**About CONSTRA**

CONSTRA is a construction intelligence platform using drone analytics, 360° camera walkthroughs, Scan-to-BIM, and AI-powered visual monitoring to help track construction progress and quality.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager – CONSTRA to take ownership of CONSTRA. You will work with engineering, design, and business teams to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver useful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the CONSTRA product roadmap and priorities in collaboration with the CTO and leadership team.

· Manage the product lifecycle from discovery and requirements gathering to prioritisation, development, release, and continuous improvement.

· Drive AI-enabled product features, including LLM-based agents for safety, defect detection, and project progress tracking.

· Work on analytics, dashboards, and workflows that help construction teams monitor project status and quality.

· Engage with site engineers, project managers, and customers to understand on-site challenges and improve product usability.

· Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; coordinate with engineering and design teams during development.

· Support sprint planning, review product builds, prioritise bugs, and help deliver releases on time.

· Work with sales and business teams on product launches, go-to-market activities, and customer feedback.

· Track product adoption, engagement, retention, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

Interact with customers for smooth rollout of product features.

**Requirements**

· 1–3 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, ConstructionTech, PropTech, or technology-driven products.

· Ability to translate user and business needs into clear product requirements.

· Understanding of agile product development and the software development lifecycle.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Exposure to AI-enabled products, construction technology, GIS, BIM, drone analytics, or visual analytics.

· Familiarity with mobile apps for field teams or offline environments.

· Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, PostHog, or Amplitude.

· A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Architecture, or a related field.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Clear communication and collaboration skills.

· A proactive approach, ownership mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\***

We are looking for a **Product Manager** who embraces an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.

**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

* Define functional and non-functional requirements and recommend solutions in the form of POCs, prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to groom stories and iterate on prototypes throughout the release cycle.
* Act as a proxy for the business throughout development, testing, and release activities to ensure business needs are met.
* Develop business analysis artifacts, such as business rules and process flows, to clarify requirements.
* Coordinate with other departments in advance of feature and product launches to develop messaging that supports and promotes new releases, features, and updates.
* Conduct product training internally and externally, including training internal trainers, developing new product and feature documentation, and introducing new functionality to internal employees and key customers.
* Provide consistency and clarity to development projects by identifying business needs and constraints, defining scope, and ensuring efficient execution.
* Design product processes that move initiatives forward using AI tooling.
* Advance the use of AI and autonomous agents to transform and accelerate the product development lifecycle.

**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**

* 4–5 years of Product Management experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products.
* Proven experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), leveraging AI across discovery, requirements, design, delivery, and product optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of defining, launching, and scaling AI-powered features, agents, automation workflows, or intelligent recommendation systems.
* Hands-on experience using Generative AI and LLM-based tools to accelerate product management workflows, improve decision-making, and increase team productivity.
* Strong understanding of AI product patterns, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Ability to identify high-value automation opportunities and translate them into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Data-driven mindset with experience defining success metrics, evaluating AI outcomes, and driving continuous product improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, implementation-ready product requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.
* Experience in PIM, PXM, DAM, Syndication, eCommerce, Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, or Distribution domains (preferred but not required).

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**
---------------------------------

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

**GDPR/CCPA**

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
LocationSan Francisco, Bangalore, or Seattle

Employment typeFull-time

Location typeIn-person

DepartmentProduct

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

job_description:
**Description**

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

**Position Description**

**Product Manager – AI & Digital Solutions**

**Role Overview**
=================

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
===============================

**Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

**Solution Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

**Solution Development & Delivery**

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

**AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

*The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of the skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the opportunity. Position Descriptions are subject to change.*

**Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**
==========================================================

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW’s commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect/Departments/Resources/ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.
* Communicate improvement ideas that you have regarding CDW service quality or client satisfaction per established means.

**CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization**
=======================================================

* We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.
* Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

**About Us**
============

* CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.
* As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.
* Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. **Together, we Make Amazing Happen.**

**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. This person will own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. You will collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness. This job is an individual contributor.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
* Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
* Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Must Have:**

* Must have atleast 3+years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead **end-to-end** product development, from discovery and solution design through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
* Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling.
* Resolve customer issues, processing challenges, and delivery blockers through hands-on problem solving and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, define success metrics, and remain accountable for product delivery and outcomes.

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

**Travel Percent:**

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

**Who We Are:**

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

**Belonging at PayPal:**

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Tech Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, development, and scaling of next-generation healthcare data and AI-driven products. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, analytics, and operations, translating complex healthcare challenges into innovative digital solutions that improve clinical, operational, and member outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong product management expertise, technical depth, healthcare domain knowledge, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value.

You will partner with engineering, architecture, data science, operations, and business stakeholders to define product vision, prioritize investments, and drive adoption of scalable solutions that support strategic healthcare initiatives.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Vision
  + Define and execute short and long-term product strategies, roadmaps, and investment priorities for healthcare technology products and platforms
  + Partner with business leaders, customers, and technology teams to identify opportunities that improve healthcare outcomes, operational efficiency, and business performance
  + Translate strategic objectives into product capabilities, business cases, and prioritized delivery plans
  + Define product success metrics, KPIs, customer outcomes, and value realization measures
* Product Ownership & Delivery
  + Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation, discovery, and definition through launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement
  + Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans
  + Prioritize and manage product backlogs to maximize customer value and business impact
  + Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements
  + Monitor product performance and continuously refine priorities based on data, customer feedback, and market insights
* Healthcare Data & AI Enablement
  + Drive development of healthcare data products, analytics platforms, AI/ML capabilities, and intelligent automation solutions
  + Collaborate with data engineering and data science teams to define data acquisition, integration, governance, analytics, and consumption strategies
  + Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, predictive analytics, machine learning, and automation to improve workflows and decision-making
  + Define requirements for APIs, interoperability solutions, reporting platforms, and healthcare data services
  + Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and regulatory requirements are embedded within product designs
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, operations, and leadership
  + Facilitate alignment across multiple teams and portfolios to deliver integrated product solutions
  + Influence priorities and drive decisions in a complex matrixed environment without direct authority
  + Communicate product vision, roadmap, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leaders and stakeholders
* Agile Execution & Operational Excellence
  + Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and prioritization activities
  + Ensure product initiatives are decomposed into actionable features and well-defined user stories
  + Manage dependencies, delivery risks, and trade-off decisions across teams
  + Leverage Agile methodologies and product management best practices to improve delivery effectiveness and speed to market
  + Drive continuous product improvement through experimentation, measurement, and customer feedback
* Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  + Present product strategy, roadmap, business value, and performance metrics to executive leadership
  + Collaborate with business development, operations, implementation, and client teams to identify emerging opportunities
  + Mentor product owners and product managers while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration
  + Act as a trusted advisor on healthcare technology trends, AI adoption, and product best practices
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in product management or equivalent
* 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Development, Digital Product Management
* 5+ years of experience defining product requirements, writing user stories, and managing Agile product backlogs
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products, platforms, or data-driven solutions
* Experience working with cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, data platforms, analytics, and digital technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, analytics, data science, and business teams
* Experience using product management and Agile tools such as Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product capabilities, business processes, or customer experiences
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and modern product management practices
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex cross-functional dependencies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within healthcare, payer, provider, population health, payment integrity, claims, clinical, or healthcare analytics domains
* Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics products
* Experience with cloud-native architectures, modern data platforms, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience leading large-scale digital transformation or enterprise modernization initiatives
* Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and business value outcomes
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards, interoperability, governance, privacy, and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with healthcare operational workflows, clinical programs, and digital health solutions
* Solid understanding of product portfolio management, roadmap planning, and investment prioritization
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across complex organizations

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

job_description:
**Job Description: Product Manager – BOSCO**

Company: Bandhoo

Location: Gurgaon.

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years

**About Bandhoo**

Bandhoo is a technology-driven company building SaaS solutions for construction project execution and workforce management.

**About BOSCO**

BOSCO is a workforce management platform that supports attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, contractor payroll, and workforce marketplace operations.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager – BOSCO to take ownership of BOSCO. You will work with engineering, design, and business teams to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver useful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the BOSCO product roadmap and priorities in collaboration with the CTO and leadership team.

· Manage the product lifecycle from user discovery and requirements gathering to prioritisation, development, release, and continuous improvement.

· Improve marketplace matching, fulfilment, user engagement, and messaging efficiency.

Using AI to match jobs with workers, for worker IVR calls and worker productivity tracking and management.

· Improve workflows for attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, and contractor payroll.

· Speak with workers, contractors, field supervisors, HR teams, and customers to understand problems and improve product usability.

· Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; coordinate with engineering and design teams during development.

· Support sprint planning, review product builds, prioritise bugs, and help deliver releases on time.

· Track product adoption, engagement, retention, matching, and fulfilment metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

· Collaborate with business and operations teams to align product improvements with customer and business needs.

**Requirements**

· 1–3 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, HRTech, workforce management, marketplaces, or operations-focused technology.

· Ability to translate user and business needs into clear product requirements.

· Understanding of agile product development and the software development lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with workforce management, contractor management, payroll, or marketplace products.

· Familiarity with mobile apps for field workers or offline environments.

· Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, PostHog, or Amplitude.

· A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Clear communication and collaboration skills.

· A proactive approach, ownership mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager (Tier 1 & 5+ Years experience)
job_description:
**About Us:**

**Luna is a health intelligence company**. Our wearables and LifeOS platform build a working model of your body, and turn it into a plan for your day. Luna Ring and Luna Band read continuous biomarker signals, from sleep and recovery to heart rate variability, circadian phase and menstrual cycle. LifeOS combines that with your nutrition, supplements, blood panels and daily context to build a plan for your day: what to do, and when to do it. Luna ships to 150+ countries, and our work has been recognised by the global tech press and international design and innovation awards.

We're grounded in science, driven by data, and occasionally powered by questionable coffee choices. But above all, we’re united by a shared mission: to reimagine how wearable tech can help people know themselves better and push their potential further.

**Your Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager – App to lead our health-tech experience and build our LifeOS.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, CX, and our beta community to deliver features that are elegant, evidence-based, and habit-forming.

**Responsibilities:**

● Own and evolve the entire Luna App roadmap, including onboarding, dashboard design,

insights, and user journeys.

● Lead product discovery and delivery for high-impact features like Energy OS, Circadian Rhythm,

Sleep Recovery and AI-based health layer.

● Have a strong understanding towards building algorithms

● Drive measurable improvements in app retention, App Store rating, feature adoption, and

session engagement.

● Translate complex physiological and behavioral science into simple, engaging app flows.

● Use data (Amplitude / Firebase / Mixpanel) to learn user behaviour

● Interact on and close the loop on feedback from beta groups and other digital communities.

**Requirements:**

*Must-Have:*

● 5+ years of product experience, with at least 2+ years leading a consumer mobile app

● Bachelors/M.S/Phd in Data Science, ML, Statistics from a Tier 1 college

● Personal interest in quantified self, training, mindfulness, sleep science, or longevity

● Experience in deep-healthtech, wellness, wearables, or fitness—with user empathy and domain

fluency.

● Exposure to AI productization, health APIs

● Strong data, algorithms understanding is critical to this role.

● Demonstrated ability to improve app retention, adoption, or ratings through thoughtful product

changes.

● Deep familiarity with mobile UX, behavioral design, and habit loop creation.

● Comfort with using data tools (Amplitude, Firebase, etc.) and setting clear success metrics.

● High clarity of thought; can operate independently, structure ambiguity, and move

cross-functional teams.

● A strong POV on what makes a truly great app experience in the wellness space.

**What You’ll Get:**

● A front-row seat to the future of wearable intelligence

● Massive ownership and impact on a fast-growing global product

● Chance to build the world’s most advanced LifeOS.

● Competitive compensation + ESOPs

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is the Notice Period in your current Company?

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
* **Product Ownership:** Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.
* **Data Versioning & Integrity:** Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.
* **AI & Automation:** Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Act as the go-to expert on private funds and alternative investments, supporting sales, client conversations, and product strategy.
* **Employee Engagement:** Participate in large-scale initiatives that promote employee retention and engagement.
* **Process Improvement:** Teach and guide other teams toward effective processes and best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
* Deep knowledge of Private Markets (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets, Fund of Funds) and the financial services landscape.
* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate across sales, product, operations, and technology.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and documentation abilities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong computer skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in product management or related roles, including experience owning a technical or data-intensive product.
* 4+ years of professional experience in Investment Management, Operations, or Accounting, with direct exposure to private funds data or workflows.
* Demonstrated experience writing business and technical requirements for a financial technology product or service.
* Experience in data visualization and analytics.
* Demonstrated client engagement experience, with a focus on understanding and addressing client needs.
* Experience presenting to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Limited Partnerships, Private Credit, Mortgage and Bank Loans, or Derivatives.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with fund administration, LP reporting, or portfolio monitoring platforms.
* Experience with master data management, entity resolution, or data quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience launching AI-enabled data extraction or document processing products.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering priorities.
* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and learning behavior.
* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.
* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.
* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.
* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.
* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and post-launch monitoring.
* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.
* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.
* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).
* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.
* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning them into product decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.
* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.
* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.
* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.
* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.
* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding platform-specific nuances.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.
* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.
* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).
* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on student performance.
* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led growth.
* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or personalization/recommendations.
* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage environments.
* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.
* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.
* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.
* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.
* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.
* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Join Stryker’s enterprise technology team and play a key role in delivering and maintaining Workday integration solutions that connect critical business systems. This position focuses on leading integration development, testing, release management, and vendor coordination while ensuring scalable, high-quality solutions that support global business operations.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the development and delivery of Workday integration solutions connecting Workday with internal and third-party systems.
* Manage multiple integration programs, tracking milestones, deliverables, risks, and overall development progress.
* Oversee integration testing activities, including code reviews, functional validation, and defect resolution.
* Configure and maintain Workday integrations using Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), APIs, XML, XSLT, and Workday Prism.
* Create and support custom reports, calculated fields, and integration frameworks to meet business requirements.
* Manage change requests and release processes, ensuring timely deployment and compliance with quality standards.
* Coordinate and review the work of external vendors and third-party development partners throughout the development lifecycle.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to resource planning, workload management, and global team initiatives.
* What You Will Need

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or enterprise application development.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Workday integration development.
* Experience with Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Workday Prism, XML, XSLT, and API integrations.
* Experience creating custom reports, calculated fields, and Workday integrations.
* Experience with Workday security configuration and business process configuration.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving Workday technical and integration issues.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience leading enterprise integration programs involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.
* Experience working in Agile software development and release management environments.
* Additional Information
* Work arrangement: Hybrid or onsite based on business needs and location requirements.
* May collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.
* Limited travel may be required based on project and business needs.
* Relocation support is subject to business requirements and local policy.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Location: India - Remote

**About Turing**
================

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

**About the Role**

Turing is looking for a high-caliber Product Manager to lead critical product areas across our talent, marketplace, vetting, and platform ecosystem. This person will step into a high-ownership role and should be able to combine strong product judgment, design taste, data-driven decision making, technical fluency, and structured business thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of user experience, systems thinking, analytics, and execution — someone who is equally comfortable shaping product direction, defining elegant user experiences, and driving cross-functional delivery in a fast-moving environment.

**Why this role matters**

Turing works with many of the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises to help build, improve, and scale advanced AI systems. We sit at the intersection of frontier AI, high-quality talent, and complex product/platform workflows - which means the problems here are real, hard, and highly consequential.

This role sits at the core of how Turing builds scalable, high-quality experiences across talent and customer workflows. The right person will help raise the bar on product execution, clarity of thinking, and quality of experience across the organization.

**What you’ll own**

You will lead product strategy and execution across some of Turing’s most important platform surfaces, including areas such as:

* Talent discovery, search, and matching
* Talent onboarding and profile quality
* Vetting, trust, and integrity systems
* Marketplace workflows and hiring manager experience
* Internal platforms and operational tooling
* Cross-functional product initiatives spanning product, engineering, design, data, and operations

**What you’ll do**

* Own roadmap, prioritization, and execution for a core product area
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured product plans, clear requirements, and strong execution
* Drive product development with a sharp eye for user experience, workflow design, and quality
* Use data deeply to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, prioritize investments, and measure impact
* Partner closely with engineering, design, data, QA, and operations to ship high-quality products quickly
* Balance short-term execution with long-term product and platform thinking
* Build scalable systems and experiences, not just one-off features
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities

**What we’re looking for**

* 2+ years of product management experience
* 2+ years of prior software engineering, Data Science, or Design experience
* Strong product sense with excellent design and UX judgment
* Highly data-driven, with the ability to use metrics, experimentation, and user insights to drive decisions
* Strong technical fluency and ability to work closely with engineering on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong structured thinking and ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-functional problems
* High ownership, urgency, and a strong bias for execution

**Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or a similarly rigorous discipline, ideally from a top-tier institution such as IIT or equivalent globally recognized universities
* MBA from a top-tier university is a plus, but not required
* Experience working on B2B SaaS, marketplace, platform, workflow, onboarding, trust/safety, search, matching, or AI-enabled products
* Strong track record of partnering closely with engineering and design teams to ship polished, high-quality user experiences

**Ideal candidate profile**

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of:

* Strong product judgment
* Sharp design instinct and high-quality bar
* Deep data-driven decision making
* Technical grounding from prior engineering experience
* Structured business thinking
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* They should be able to look at a messy problem, identify the highest-leverage opportunity, craft an elegant user experience, back decisions with data, and drive execution end to end.

**Values**
----------

* **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
* **We work at Start-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
* **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

**Advantages of joining Turing**
--------------------------------

* **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
* **Contribute to leading-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
* **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
* **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
* **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.
  

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Missions
job_description:
**Company Description**

**About Entain India**

There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description**

This is a hybridrole. As a Senior Product Manager - Missions you will be responsible for leading a cross-functional squad focused on solving a clearly defined, high-value customer or business problem.

Working with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to own measurable outcomes from strategy and discovery through to delivery.

Reporting to the Director of Product you will be part of the Product team, who will own a strategically important mission and its outcomes from end to end. Shape the product strategy, roadmap and priorities around a measurable customer or business problem.

You Will:

* Shape the product strategy, roadmap and priorities around a measurable customer or business problem.
* Lead discovery and delivery with engineering, design, data and commercial partners.
* Use customer insight, data and experimentation to test assumptions and adapt investment decisions.
* Define success metrics and align stakeholders around priorities, dependencies and trade-offs.

 **Qualifications**

You Have:

* More than five years' product management experience, with a track record of taking consumer products from concept to market.
* Experience leading cross-functional product squads against clearly defined customer or business outcomes.
* Experience turning broad or ambiguous problems into measurable outcomes, hypotheses and priorities.
* Strong experience using quantitative data, customer insight, experimentation and research to make evidence-based decisions

  
**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain India, we offer a package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3).

**How we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) in recruitment**

We may use approved AI tools to make recruitment simpler and more efficient, while keeping people at the heart of what we do. These tools support our teams and give them more time to focus on you.

**Fairness, transparency and trust**

Our recruiters and hiring managers oversee how we use AI and remain responsible for hiring decisions. These tools support administrative aspects of the recruitment process, giving our teams more time to focus on you We're open about its use and handle your information following our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. AI supports our decisions, it doesn't make them.

**Equal Opportunities**.

If you need any **reasonable adjustments** at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an **equal opportunities employer**. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Powered by an outstanding end-to-end e-commerce and logistics network and a fanatical culture of customer centricity, Coupang has broken tradeoffs around speed, selection, and price. Today, we provide exceedingly fast shipping speeds on millions of items including fresh groceries, delivered within hours nationwide, 365 days a year. We are doing this for millions of consumers in Korea, one of the world's largest and fastest growing e-commerce markets. Korea is currently the 5th largest e-commerce market in the world.  
Finance Platform and Engineering (FPE) Product team owns the procure-to-cash, order- to-cash and sellers' settlement experience across various business verticals at Coupang.  
Our team collaborates with various Engineering, Finance, Seller Experience and Support teams to ensure that all transactions produced by the various platforms at Coupang with financial impact are accurately accounted for to ensure that our suppliers and sellers are paid precisely and on-time.  
  
**Job Description:**

  

We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced, and dynamic Senior Product Manager to own and drive the product strategy for how sellers interact with and consume their settlement data through the seller portal. This role focuses on ensuring that sellers have easy, intuitive, and transparent access to critical financial data, empowering them to understand and manage their payments effectively.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for how to evolve the seller settlement experience

* Drive end-to-end product development, from ideation and requirements gathering to release and continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, design, data, and finance teams

* Regularly engage with external customers and internal partner teams to gather

product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and

preview programs

* Define and prioritize product features, user stories, and acceptance criteria,

maintaining a well-groomed backlog and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality

releases

* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and drive continuous improvement, adjusting the roadmap and strategy as

needed

* Communicate product status, progress and insights to stakeholders and

leadership, fostering a culture of transparency, collaboration, and data-driven

decision making

* Champion a customer-centric approach to product development, acting as an

advocate for user needs and fostering a culture of empathy and innovation

  

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance or

equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of product/program management, solutions architecture, or engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex, large-scale technical

products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset and

commitment to evidence-based decision making.

* Demonstrates the ability to quickly grasp new concepts, technologies, and

industry trends, adapting to a constantly evolving business landscape and staying ahead of the curve.

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

* Proven ability to balance competing priorities, manage multiple projects

simultaneously, and deliver results under varying constraints.

* Consistently works backwards from customers' needs, ensuring that productdecisions are driven by a thorough understanding of user requirements, pain

points and jobs to be done.

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA or equivalent degree is a strong plus.

* Knowledge of accounting principles, financial systems, and industry best practices, with a strong understanding of the unique challenges faced by eCommerce businesses.

* Experience building and launching Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).

Job Title: Senior Product Manager

**Company:** Eminence Technology  
**Location:** Mohali, Punjab  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** Night Shift  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Eminence Technology

Eminence Technology is an IT product and services company focused on delivering innovative, technology-driven solutions. We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior Product Manager** to join our team in Mohali and drive product strategy, development, and business growth.

Job Overview
