job_description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Product Manager- TechnicalOverview  
MasterCard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  
• We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise• We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behaviour beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data• We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and moreThe MasterCard Data & Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services. This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution. Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard • Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value • Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products• Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams• Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments• Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs  
  
Role  

* Own, define and deliver end-to-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch
* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities
* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

• Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features•  
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives  

* Oversee timely and high-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements
* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals
* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team
* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership
* Promote internal and external feature adoption
* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support
* Provide input into product pricing and our go-to-market strategy
* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  
All About You  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness
* Requires minimal supervision/assistance
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

• Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)•
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

• Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus• Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI** 
 
**The Opportunity**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Are you an experienced Product Manager with strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and a passion for turning data into action? If so, join our team and help shape how Nutanix measures product adoption, customer value realization, and business outcomes across our portfolio.

In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights. You will partner closely with Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to build trusted adoption metrics, actionable insights, and AI-powered recommendations that help improve customer adoption, retention, and growth.

### **Your Role:**

* Define and drive strategy and roadmap for Product Adoption & Insights initiatives across the Nutanix portfolio.
* Partner with Product Managers, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to gather requirements and identify opportunities to improve adoption, customer health, and value realization.
* Define and evolve adoption frameworks, telemetry requirements, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
* Build AI-powered actionable insights that help Customer Success and Account teams proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify new opportunities and drive prioritization.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and enablement across Product, Customer Success, Field, and Corporate Strategy organizations.

### **What You Will Bring:**

* B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field is required. MBA preferred.
* 7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management. Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products is highly desirable.
* Strong experience in strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and product execution.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with telemetry, product usage analytics, AI-powered recommendations, customer health metrics, or business intelligence solutions is preferred.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

### **About the Team**

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, responsible for Product Adoption & Insights, NIVA (Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent), Customer Success, and Professional Services Strategy.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

job_description:
**Job title:** Senior Product Manager – Edge Platform.

**Job type:** Full time, Permanent.

**Location:**  Bangalore

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the day-to-day product management and delivery of our Edge Compute platform.

The role sits at the intersection of product, software engineering, infrastructure, operations and consuming teams. You will translate consumer needs and strategic priorities into clear product outcomes, work closely with Engineering to drive delivery, and coordinate across Programme Management and Operations to ensure capabilities are successfully delivered and operationalised.

This is a highly technical product role requiring strong product judgement, technical fluency and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, engineering-led environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product execution: Manage and prioritise the product backlog, lead planning and refinement, clarify requirements and acceptance criteria, and work with Engineering to resolve product questions and delivery blockers.
* Partner with consumers: Understand and triage requests from teams using the Edge platform, translate needs into product requirements, manage expectations and ensure the platform continues to meet consumer needs.
* Drive engineering & operational alignment: Partner closely with Software Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Security and Operations to deliver reliable, secure and supportable platform capabilities. Ensure workflows and automation built by Engineering are operationally ready and can be effectively adopted and run by Operations.
* Coordinate programmes: Work closely with Programme Management to align product delivery with wider programme milestones, dependencies, risks and commitments, ensuring issues are surfaced and managed early.
* Evolve the platform: Translate the Edge product strategy and roadmap into actionable initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify infrastructure consumption through automation, APIs and self-service capabilities.
* Drive outcomes: Balance consumer experience, engineering effort, scalability, reliability, security and operational supportability when making product decisions.

**Experience**

* Experience managing platform, infrastructure or developer-focused products from discovery through delivery.
* Strong experience working day-to-day with engineering teams, including backlog management, prioritisation, sprint planning and requirements definition.
* Experience working with multiple consuming teams and coordinating complex cross-team dependencies.
* Background in technical domains such as compute, networking, cloud/edge platforms, APIs or automation.
* Experience working in complex enterprise environments across Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Operations and Programme Management.

**Skills**

* Strong product discovery, prioritisation and delivery skills.
* Technical fluency across infrastructure and software engineering, with an understanding of APIs, automation and platform technologies.
* Ability to move confidently between technical detail, consumer needs and business outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills.
* Highly organised, pragmatic and comfortable operating in an engineering-led environment with ambiguity and competing priorities.

Pay: Up to ₹4,800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager - Value Based Care Analytics
job_description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

**Position Summary**: We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Value-Based Care Analytics & Performance team within our Clinicals division in **Bangalore**. In this role you will be responsible for defined problem spaces within the VBC Analytics & Performance roadmap, developing deep expertise in our users, customers, and workflows and ensuring product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into VBC analytics workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare practices.

You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in clinical outcomes, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.

**About the Team**: The Value-Based Care Analytics & Performance team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to drive industry-leading outcomes and optimize revenue in value-based care arrangements. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI-enabled solutions where they add value. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive product vision incorporating AI-enabled capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities.
* Translate product strategy into outcome-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Lead early-stage discovery, including identifying high-value use cases, validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and defining data requirements and feasibility.
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate functional requirements, user experience considerations, data and model requirements, and AI behavior expectations.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI-enabled product capabilities.
* Participate in scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, readouts, and retrospectives.
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Monitor post-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Partner with UX, Analytics, and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance including validity, bias, data quality, adoption, and impact.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Champion responsible AI practices including safety testing, bias evaluation, and explainability.
* Own go-to-market strategies for assigned products, including AI-enabled features.
* Gain alignment from multiple stakeholders, manage product dependencies, and negotiate trade-offs across product areas.
* Understand dependencies across athenaOne and collaborate with Product Management peers to coordinate work across related product areas.
* Engage with Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding, and Product Marketing to gather insights, communicate product direction, and support adoption.
* Communicate product strategy, priorities, progress, and risks to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Contribute product knowledge to strengthen product management practices and support the development of colleagues.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree required; Degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field preferred. Masters preferred.
* 10+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 6+ years in Product Management
* Demonstrated success establishing product vision, priorities, and roadmaps, and owning complex product problems from discovery through delivery and measurement
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, navigate ambiguity, and make clear decisions about where to focus
* Ability to build alignment across stakeholders, manage dependencies, and make informed trade-offs among customer needs, business objectives, and delivery considerations
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum engineering teams as a Product Owner
* Experience defining and using product metrics and validation methods to assess customer value and inform decisions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics understandable to customers, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners
* Understanding of healthcare/health IT environments and clinical workflows, or ability to quickly develop domain expertise
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, responsible AI principles, model bias, explainability, and the full AI/ML lifecycle
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate product development work, with appropriate human review
* Technical understanding of data, APIs, and SaaS - ability to assess feasibility and remove development barriers

**Additional Information**

Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations and industry events (5%)

***About athenahealth***

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

*Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers*

*https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal-opportunity*

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Service & Experience portfolio, ensuring that global People services, employee and manager journeys, case management, knowledge, self-service and lifecycle automation are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will lead and develop the Service & Experience product team and work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function.

  

You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Security, Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers. The portfolio initially centres on ServiceNow HRSD and is expected to include Qualtrics and colleague-listening capabilities, alongside integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise platforms.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. You will help the business establish consistent global ways of working and create joined-up employee and manager journeys, while ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable business value today and evolves towards stronger experience design, orchestration, automation and self-service.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
* The People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Service & Experience portfolio, ensuring that global People services, employee and manager journeys, case management, knowledge, self-service and lifecycle automation are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.
* Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will lead and develop the Service & Experience product team and work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function.
* You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Security, Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers. The portfolio initially centres on ServiceNow HRSD and is expected to include Qualtrics and colleague-listening capabilities, alongside integrations with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise platforms.
* You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Service & Experience portfolio. You will help the business establish consistent global ways of working and create joined-up employee and manager journeys, while ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable business value today and evolves towards stronger experience design, orchestration, automation and self-service.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including product ownership, roadmap planning, workflow or service development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities and translating business requirements, service challenges and strategic objectives into measurable digital outcomes.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, service-management or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service and workflow automation.
* Experience designing or improving employee and manager journeys, services or lifecycle events across multiple business functions.
* Experience supporting global service standardisation while balancing regional, operational and regulatory requirements.
* Experience managing product demand, incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience owning delivery outcomes through internal teams, integrated delivery teams and third-party implementation or support partners.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and non-People functions to define responsibilities, requirements and hand-offs within cross-functional services or lifecycle journeys.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing product governance, processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy, service transformation and experience-design objectives.
* Experience using platform performance, service information, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continual improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification.
* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery implementation, product or specialist certification.
* Additional ServiceNow certifications relating to platform implementation, application development, workflow automation, service management or customer workflows.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise employee-service portfolios.
* Experience with Qualtrics or comparable colleague-listening, survey or experience-management platforms.
* Experience applying service design, experience design, journey mapping or user-centred design practices.
* Experience designing or managing global service catalogues, service taxonomies, case-management models or knowledge-management frameworks.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle orchestration across People, IT, Security, Facilities, Procurement, Learning, identity or background-screening processes.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products or other enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating-model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, super-user groups, champion networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications: Desirable**

  

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* ServiceNow HR Service Delivery certification
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist certification
* Qualtrics certification or relevant experience-management qualification
  

**Product and Delivery**

  

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
  

**Scrum Product Owner**

* Scrum Master
  

**Service and Experience Management**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* Service design or experience-design qualification
  

Journey-mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design certification

This role is expected to help build and mature the People Technology function and establish Service & Experience as a strategic product capability, rather than simply operate an established ServiceNow platform.

  

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Senior Product Manager (Salesforce Integration)
job_description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the role:**

Cvent's acquisition strategy has brought together some of the most recognized names in event technology, each with their own Salesforce-native application used by event marketers and meeting professionals worldwide. As we integrate these businesses, we're creating a dedicated role to bring unified ownership, strategic clarity, and a cohesive customer experience across our entire Salesforce app portfolio.  
This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM ecosystems, enterprise SaaS, and portfolio strategy. You'll be the single accountable owner across five Salesforce applications — setting the overarching strategy, driving day-to-day roadmap decisions, and ensuring Cvent stays ahead of Salesforce's evolving platform requirements.

In This Role, You Will::

Own a Portfolio of Salesforce Products  

* Serve as the single accountable owner across a portfolio of five Salesforce-native applications spanning our event technology brands — setting strategy, driving roadmap decisions, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.
* Lead our flagship Salesforce application as your core product, managing its end-to-end roadmap and balancing new feature investment against technical debt.
* Shepherd an acquired application from beta through General Availability, working closely with customers and go-to-market teams to define readiness criteria and launch successfully.
* Partner with PMs across acquired brands to align product direction and ensure cohesion across the portfolio.
* Where leadership decides to consolidate apps, own the migration workstream — defining requirements and partnering with Customer Success to ensure a seamless transition for customers.

Define the Salesforce Strategy  

* Determine whether and how Cvent moves toward a unified Salesforce app experience across acquired brands.
* Keep all applications ahead of mandatory Salesforce platform updates, security requirements, and AppExchange compliance changes.
* Make high-stakes prioritization calls across five products simultaneously — where to invest, what to consolidate, and how to sequence the roadmap.
* Embed AI as a default lens across product decisions; champion AI-native processes within your team.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment  

* Act as the single point of accountability for product decisions across the portfolio; own escalation paths and surface risks proactively.
* Lead alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, UX, and acquired-company partners.
* Use data — analytics platforms, customer feedback, and OKRs — to guide prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

Here's What You Need::

* 12+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with direct experience shipping Salesforce-native or deeply integrated CRM products.
* Salesforce AppExchange or managed package experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-product roadmaps — especially in post-acquisition or multi-brand environments.
* Experience owning customer migration or product consolidation workstreams.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and a track record of embedding AI into PM workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Mixpanel or similar to drive adoption and measure impact.
* Exceptional communicator — comfortable aligning leadership team, engineering, and external partners around a shared product vision.

job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role:**

The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.

  
  

You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.

**What you will accomplish:**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. Experience working with design research and qualitative tools to ensure the voice of our seller is at the center of our product development
* Strong, concise communicator and effective story-teller; experience using both analytics and qualitative research to express the vision and strategy of the product
* Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering or Business management.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Apply Now

title: Engineering Product Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Product Owner - Travel & Expenses (T&E) and Fieldglass
job_description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

  

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner for our Travel & Expense Applications, including Concur, Cognos Reporting for Concur, AmexGBT & related online booking tools, SpotMe, and CVent. The primary focus of this role will be on Concur, ensuring its readiness and integration with SAP ECC during the migration to S4Hana. The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering business-initiated projects, managing technical operations, and ensuring service management and business continuity.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Product Ownership and Strategy:**
  + Manage the product vision and strategy for Travel & Expense Applications, with a primary focus on Concur.
  + Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and prioritize requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* **Project Management:**
  + Lead the Concur satellite project, ensuring the readiness of Concur during the SAP ECC to S4Hana migration.
  + Deliver projects initiated by the business for Concur and other Travel & Expense applications, ensuring they meet quality, scope, and timeline requirements.
  + Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and procurement, to ensure successful project execution.
* **Service Management:**
  + Manage technical operations for all Travel & Expense applications, including Concur, AmexGBT, SpotMe, and Cvent to meet the SLA agreed with business for tech products.
  + Oversee tech audits, compliance activities, application onboarding activities and service stabilization efforts to ensure business continuity.
  + Stabilize and monitor service management processes, including incident, problem, and change management ensuring outcome driven approach
* **Technical Operations and Compliance:**
  + Ensure the technical health and performance of Travel & Expense applications through regular monitoring and maintenance.
  + Support technical audits and compliance activities to meet regulatory and internal standards.
  + Address and resolve technical issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring a seamless user experience.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  + Engage with key stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations, providing regular updates on product and project status.
  + Foster strong relationships with vendors and partners, ensuring effective collaboration and support.
  + Act as the primary point of contact for Travel & Expense application-related queries and escalations.
* **Scope and Responsibilities for S4 for T&E:**
  + Ensure Concur's readiness and integration with SAP ECC during the migration to S4Hana, focusing on seamless and efficient transition.
  + Manage the end-to-end process of integrating Travel & Expense (T&E) applications with the new S4Hana environment, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  + Collaborate closely with SAP project teams to align T&E processes and configurations with the capabilities and requirements of S4Hana.
  + Monitor and evaluate the performance of T&E applications post-migration, implementing necessary adjustments and improvements to optimize functionality within the S4Hana framework.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Travel & Expense applications.
  + Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, integrating relevant advancements into the product roadmap.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role, with a focus on Travel & Expense applications.
* Strong knowledge of Concur and its integration with ERP systems, particularly SAP ECC and S4Hana.
* Experience managing technical operations, including tech audits, compliance activities, and service stabilization.
* Excellent project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Knowledge of service management frameworks (e.g., ITIL) is a plus.
  

**Filedglass Senior Product Owner (50 % involvement)**

  

* **Quality, Risk & Compliance** : Accountable for ensuring all products supporting the business are compliant with internal security, risk management policies and practices, external regulatory and statutory requirements e.g. GxP, SARBOX and that Tech continuity plans are in place for all business-critical products

* Experience of audit and documenting the privileged access control, adhering to internal and external risk compliance.

  
  

* **Stakeholder Management:**

o Engage with key stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations, providing regular updates on product and project status.

o Foster strong relationships with vendors and partners, ensuring effective collaboration and support.

o Act as the primary point of contact for Fieldglass technical queries and escalations.

  
  

* **Technical Configuration/Customization** : Work with third party solutions providers and GSK Staff, developers, and GSK Core Technology/Platforms to conduct technical configuration/customization of solutions that meet our customers needs and provides a great user experience. Ensures the SAP design is managed and controlled to maintain integrity of the ERP template. Drive synergies across the different modules (Fieldglass / Ariba) in the Procurement area.

  
  

* **Data Protection** : Develop a sound knowledge of GSK policies and processes regarding protection of sensitive data

* Governance & Product Assessment: Take part in technical governance and oversight of product development across a product domain. Support Solutions Architect in the assessment of technology solutions

  
  

* **Product Domain** : Understand the product domain and GA&D roadmap from a technology perspective but also understand how the technology adds value

  
  

* **Quality, Risk & Compliance** : Accountable for ensuring all products supporting the business are compliant with internal security, risk management policies and practices, external regulatory and statutory requirements e.g. GxP, SARBOX and that Tech continuity plans are in place for all business-critical products

  
  

* **Change & Release management** : Manage change activity, including Software as a Service delivered change, into the production service in a compliant and efficient manner

  
  

* **Integrations** : Ensure data passing from upstream systems or providers (i.e. Workday) or to downstream systems (i.e. Global ERP) through integrations is efficient, accurate and secure. This also includes building reporting capabilities that support both operational reporting as well as analytic reporting.

  
  

* **Process Improvement** : Drive ongoing product and technical improvements adopting a mixture of delivery methodologies where appropriate – but focusing on Value to the customers.

  
  

* **Technical Product Deliverables** : Ensuring completion of technical deliverables as outlined by Product Owner/GRC and ensuring technical aspects of definition of done are achieved.

* Ensures product changes and projects are deploy successfully and deliver the value defined

* Ensure Strategic Suppliers (SI) and CWs are delivering quality and to their SOW agreed.

* Manage the overall SI to deliver to milestones, targets and metrics.

* Support and drive the mix of on-shore / off-shore resource.

* Support and drive the reduction of CW and increased use of Strategic Supplier Staff.

* Operational Support

* Supervise Consultants working on support activities, ensuring that they are able to fulfil their responsibilities to review progress, identify and resolve blockages, ensure SLAs are met and that the production systems are not put at risk resource.

* Work on support tickets and escalations providing resolution to break-fix issues, and deployment of operational changes. Demonstrate an ability to resolve complex issues, manage user relationships and delivery

* Proactively seek ways to reduce the volume of support work, by working with suppliers to improve service, identifying common/recurring issues, and proposing improvements.

  

We are looking for a Professional and if you have these skills, we would like to speak to you.

* Degree, min. 5 years relevant (e.g. R&D, Commercial, Corporate, GMS) experience in major global Tech organization.

* Skill- Fieldglass implementation/configuration.

* Key understanding of all modules in Field glass and configuration manager, Interfaces, integration support.

* Demonstrate previous Fieldglass roll outs and implementation

* Track record in successful technical development, solution design, programme and product delivery and service management

* Experience as a Technical Analyst

* Experience of working with third parties in the delivery of working products

* Excellent relationship management, strong influencing, and communication skills

* Deep content knowledge of respective functional area (business operating models, processes & products)

* Understanding of Agile Software Development, experience in Scrum, Kanban, SAFE desirable

* Understanding of Emergn VFQ desirable

* Understanding and fit to GSK Values and Expectations.

* Expert in SAP configuration preferably with SAP certification in respective area of expertise

* Typically, 3 end-to-end market/site implementation project lifecycles

* Practical experience of global design and SAP solutions in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment – not necessary- desirable.

* Planning and delivering of their own work is required, must be capable of following a detailed plan and reporting metrics, achievements and resolving impediments

* Work in partnership and drive successful delivery of 3rd Parties, including work off-shore

  

**Skills**

Capacity Planning, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Disaster Recovery (DR), Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, Network Configurations, Network Troubleshooting, Operations Analysis, Performance Tuning, Service Level Agreement (SLA), System Monitors, Vulnerability Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.
