author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview**

Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.

* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.

* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.

* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

  
  
  

Applied Sciences IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 - $234,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $160,200 - $261,000 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:  
https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

text:
**Overview**

Security is one of the most critical challenges facing organisations today. Threats are becoming more sophisticated, enterprise environments are increasingly diverse, and AI is rapidly changing both how attacks are carried out and how security products are built and operated.

Microsoft Security is looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of security experiences across endpoint.

We are looking for a security-first product leader with strong technical depth and experience building enterprise security products. The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as endpoint security, Microsoft Intune, device management or mobile security, along with a strong understanding of how AI is transforming security and product development.

This role requires more than traditional product management. We are looking for someone who can use AI to fundamentally improve the PM craft, accelerating customer discovery, research, analysis, product definition and prototyping, while applying strong judgement to turn insights into the right product investments.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will:

* Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap and execution for key endpoint, device and mobile security scenarios.

* Develop a deep understanding of customers, threat trends and emerging security challenges, and translate them into clear product opportunities.

* Partner across engineering, security research, design and product teams to drive clarity, alignment and execution of complex, cross-team security initiatives.

* Define and drive security experiences spanning endpoint protection, detection, investigation and response, device security and mobile protection.

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve security outcomes, including faster protection, detection, investigation, response and security operations.

* Leverage AI across the product management lifecycle to accelerate customer insights, product analysis, requirements, prototyping and experimentation, enabling faster and higher-quality product decisions.

* Engage directly with enterprise customers, security operations teams and IT administrators to understand unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Make product prioritisation decisions based on security risk, customer impact, product data and business opportunity.

* Define measurable product outcomes and continuously evaluate adoption, effectiveness and customer value.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Significant product management experience delivering complex enterprise or technical products.
* 8 + Yrs of experience in product management

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security products or closely related enterprise security technologies.

* Proven experience taking major product capabilities from customer problem and product strategy through engineering execution, launch and adoption.

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams on architecture, design and security trade-offs.

* Strong customer orientation, with demonstrated ability to translate customer and market insights into product strategy and priorities.

* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments and influence without direct authority.

* Experience working with large enterprise customers and security operations or IT administration personas.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Endpoint Security: Deep understanding of endpoint protection, threat detection, and endpoint detection and response across modern enterprise environments.

* Device & Mobile Security: Experience with Microsoft Intune or equivalent device management and security solutions, including mobile device/application management, device compliance, and Android/iOS security.

* Enterprise & Cross-Platform Security: Experience securing diverse environments across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with a strong understanding of the needs of large enterprise customers, security operations teams, and IT administrators.

job_description:
**About the role**
------------------

Kapture CX is looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own guest experience, reservation, inventory management products for enterprise customers in the cruise, airline and hospitality space.

You will work with customers' business teams to understand how they sell and service their products, and turn that into product strategy, specs and designs that engineering teams build and ship. The ideal candidate combines travel/cruiseline -domain depth, technical fluency and strong stakeholder management.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product strategy and ownership**

* Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Central Reservation System and corresponding modules.
* Translate customer business needs and pain points into prioritised product initiatives with clear outcomes.
* Balance customer requests, platform scalability and technical debt when setting priorities.
* Track industry trends and competitor products in travel and hospitality tech. (Good to have)

### **Technical product delivery**

* Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria; create product workflows and designs for engineering teams.
* Lead cross-functional development and QA teams through sprint planning, release and UAT.
* Work with architects on APIs, integrations, data models and non-functional requirements such as performance and scalability.
* Use prototypes to validate requirements with customers before full build.

### **Data and continuous improvement**

* Define product KPIs and track adoption, performance and business impact.
* Use SQL and analytics tools to analyse product data, validate system behaviour and find improvement opportunities.
* Drive root-cause analysis of production issues and data-quality gaps.

### **Customer and stakeholder management**

* Run discovery workshops with enterprise customers to understand processes, pain points and goals.
* Present roadmaps, release plans and product performance to senior customer and internal stakeholders.
* Manage critical issues and escalations through to resolution.
* Identify where AI and automation (AI Voice, Chat, Agent Assist, Intelligent Workflows) can improve booking and servicing journeys.

**Key requirements**
--------------------

* 5-10 years of total experience, with 3+ years in product management (5+ years for the Senior level).
* Domain experience in cruise line, airline or hospitality technology. **(Mandatory)**
* Hands-on experience with a Central Reservation System, booking engine or reservations platform.
* Working knowledge of inventory management, pricing and distribution concepts.
* Technical fluency with REST APIs, integrations, data models and SQL.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering and QA teams in an agile environment.
* Experience working with enterprise B2B customers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.
* Shift timing will be 3pm to 12am as the primary market would be US/EU. **(Mandate & should be comfortable in working)**

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience with travel platforms or standards such as GDS, OTA integrations or OpenTravel.
* Background in B2B SaaS, CRM or contact-centre platforms.
* Exposure to revenue management, demand forecasting or AI/ML in travel.
* Experience with data warehouses and BI tools.
* Experience with prototyping tools
* Prior experience in customer success or account management.

Job Description:

**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**

Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.

**You Will:**

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Dev & Integration
job_description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

  

**Job Purpose:**

The Associate Director, Product Owner - Development & Integration is responsible for maximising the value of their HR Product portfolio (MCP, APIs, Satellite Apps, SuccessFactors Integration ecosystem) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the HR product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the SD Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Technical Development & Integration Product Owner guides Associate Product Owners and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes (GXP), obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change
  

**Skills**

Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, Enterprise Application, Enterprise Systems Integration, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), Integration Engineering, Microarchitecture, Microservices Architecture, Phenom (Platform), Product Strategies, SAP SuccessFactors, Services Management, Technical Designs, Workday Extend Development, Workday HCM  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

**Job description:**

We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

The candidate will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms
* Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories
* Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking
* Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics
* Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials
* Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field
* 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments
* Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics
* Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello
* Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle
* Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms
* Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences
* Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus
* Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

**Deployment Location: Goa**  
**Work Mode: Onsite (Mon-Sat)**

Job Type: Contractual- 1 year (Can extend up to 6 months based on project requirements)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Director, Product Owner - MyLearning
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Associate Director, Product Owner - MyLearning is responsible for maximising the value of their HR Product (SuccessFactors) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the HR product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The my Learning Product Owner guides Associate Product Owners and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

  
  

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes (GXP), obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Must have knowledge of SAP Successfactors and experience of deploying globally.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
Comfortable with ambiguity and change  

**Skills**

Automation, Compliance Management, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Platform Management, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Regulatory Training, SAP SuccessFactors, User Experience (UX)  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

The ODS Product Owner guides Associate Product Owners and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

  
  

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required SOX standards, security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the SD, Head of Talent + L&D Digital & Tech and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Knowledge of functional domains within Global Functions (e.g. HR) and familiarity with the technology platforms that enable them (e.g. Workday).
* Understanding of product performance measures and KPIs, with the ability to drive improvements in product adoption, cycle time, stability, support effort, and overall user experience.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills** :

  

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change
  

**Skills**

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Management, Design Thinking, Digital Solutions, Human Resources Integration, Operational Data Store (ODS), Product Delivery, Requirements Gathering, Structured Query Language (SQL), Workday HCM

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

  

**Job Purpose:**

The Associate Director, Product Owner - Workday Integrations is responsible for maximising the value of their product (Workday Integrations) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the HR product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Workday Integrations Product Owner guides delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Associate Product Owners and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and the VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Knowledge of functional domains within Workday and broader HR technology ecosystem.
* Deep technical expertise over Workday Integrations.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change.
  

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, DevOps, Digital Solutions, Product Delivery, Product Strategies, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Story, Web Services, Workday EIB, Workday Integration, Workday Studio  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. **Job Purpose:**

They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Time & Absence Product Owner guides delivery and operational support teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational effectiveness.

  
  

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the functional and technical SME for **Workday Time and Absence** , offering expert guidance on configuration, statutory compliance, and best practice.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Senior Director, People Services & Reward, and VP HR Digital & Tech.
* Serve as the escalation point for HR Product teams and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Director, Workday, Payroll & Time Product Manager and VP, HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Senior Director, People Services & Reward, and VP HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Hands-on experience in **Workday Time & Absence configuration,** including at least one full implementation or major re-configuration project.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption; experience with Workday release testing and regression cycles.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change
  

**Skills**

Attendance Management, Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Time Management, Workday Absence Management, Workday Implementation, Workday Time Tracking  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. **Job Purpose:**

  

The **Associate Director, Product Owner - Legal Ops** is responsible for maximising the value of the Legal Operations product group across the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Dir, Legal Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Legal Operations Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness. The role is accountable for ensuring Products in the Legal Ops domain have bold, data powered roadmaps.

  
  

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Dir, Legal Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc) for all Legal Ops products ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Dir, Legal Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required digital & tech governance, in line with our digital & tech management system (DTMS), security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Dir, Legal Product Manager and Dir, Domain Architecture.

* Partner with Legal business stakeholders on the roadmap and vision for the products in this domain – including for Legal document management, Legal matter management, eBilling, Contract Lifecycle management and Legal AI products/LLMs being explored as part of Legal & Compliance Digital Transformation.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.

* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working within Enterprise Technology, Product and Service Management, Legal technologies
* Knowledge of Legal Operations technologies such as legal document management, legal matter management, eBilling, contract lifecycle management, legal AI platforms.
* Knowledge of systems such as NetDocs, Ascent, Ironclad, Persuit, Harvey, Legora, Vincent is extremely advantageous.
* Understanding of product performance measures and KPIs, with the ability to drive improvements in product adoption, cycle time, stability, support effort, and overall user experience.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes including being strong at communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and confidence working with lawyers at varying levels of seniority
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.

* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.

**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.  
3. Provides subject matter expertise on complex products, processes, services, or product life-cycle activities, advising stakeholders on risks, opportunities, dependencies, and potential solutions.  
4. Partners with senior functional leaders, business line stakeholders, Legal, regulatory contacts, and cross-functional partners to interpret business challenges, align priorities, and support strategic and operational decision-making.  
5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.  
10. Serves as a technical or functional resource for colleagues by sharing expertise, providing guidance on complex matters, and supporting consistent execution of product-related work.  
11. Performs all duties according to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or field, with the ability to apply that expertise to complex product management work.
* Strong business acumen and ability to interpret internal and external business challenges to recommend best practices, product enhancements, or process improvements.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate collaboration or escalation.
* Ability to influence outcomes, negotiate change, and guide stakeholders across areas of responsibility without direct people management authority.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise senior functional management and build strategic relationships across the function.
* Experience leading complex initiatives, coordinating cross-functional work, and maintaining execution discipline across multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Knowledge of product management activities, operational processes, controls, risk considerations, and product life-cycle requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Ability to use data, metrics, reporting, and performance information to guide recommendations, measure outcomes, and improve product or process effectiveness.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s/University degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing complex products, processes, programs, or initiatives; advising stakeholders on product-related matters; and influencing cross-functional outcomes in alignment with business objectives.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 2 years as Senior Consultant/Associate Specialist/Section Manager/Operations Manager to move as a Specialist
* 1 year as Division Manager to move as a Specialist

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.
